verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: brand, big two-line headline, can, CTA. But the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an illegible speck, the missing-asset sticker is cropped into a garbled box crammed beside the can and NEW badge, and the legal copy is jammed under the CTA. B's one-line headline runs straight into the CTA pill ('sparkling' touches the button), and the NEW badge, legal line and cropped sticker are piled into a cramped strip under the headline. The can is stranded far left with dead space around it, and the logo is tiny here too.
